p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/routing-cadence-check.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p"
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/compact-policy.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" session-start
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/improve-nudge.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" session-start
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/compact-policy.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" prompt
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/improve-nudge.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" prompt
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/instructions-inventory.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p"

p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/governor-hook.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\042\047\134' | LC_ALL=C grep -qiF -e pytest -e py.test -e docker || exit 0; { printf '%s %s %s start\n' "$(date +%s)" "${p##*/}" $$ >> "$HOME/.gearbox-state/hook-timing.log"; } 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$in" | python3 "$p"; s=$?; { printf '%s %s %s end %s\n' "$(date +%s)" "${p##*/}" $$ $s >> "$HOME/.gearbox-state/hook-timing.log"; } 2>/dev/null; [ $s -eq 0 ] || { echo "governor-hook: present but exited $s without rendering a decision - refusing this Bash call. Fix or remove $p." >&2; exit 2; }

p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/git-tree-guard.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; f(){ echo "git-tree-guard: $p failed ($1) - the guard itself failed, not the command. Refusing this Bash call; the same command can be tried again." >&2; exit 2; }; in=$(cat) || f read; t=$(printf '%s' "$in" | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\042\047\134') || f strip; [ -z "$in" ] || [ -n "$t" ] || f strip; case "$t" in *[gG][iI][tT]*) ;; *) case "$in" in *'\u'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac;; esac; { printf '%s %s %s start\n' "$(date +%s)" "${p##*/}" $$ >> "$HOME/.gearbox-state/hook-timing.log"; } 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$in" | python3 "$p"; s=$?; { printf '%s %s %s end %s\n' "$(date +%s)" "${p##*/}" $$ $s >> "$HOME/.gearbox-state/hook-timing.log"; } 2>/dev/null; [ $s -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $s -eq 2 ] && exit 2; f "exit $s"
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/verify-state-guard.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p"
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/safe-refactor-advisory.sh"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec bash "$p"
~/.claude/hooks/dispatch-audit.py
~/.claude/hooks/skill-usage-log.py
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-elapsed-nag.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; python3 "$p" pre
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/improve-nudge.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" finished
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-elapsed-nag.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; python3 "$p" stop
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/compact-policy.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" pre-compact
p="$HOME/.claude/hooks/compact-policy.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p" post-compact

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
